name: The long-distance letter
description: Built for the miles in between: a countdown to the next time you're together, sealed notes for the hard days, and a letter that unlocks later.
tagline: For when you can't be there

defaults.title: Until I see you
defaults.openingMessage: I couldn't be there, so I made this instead.

copy.envelope.title: From a long way away.
copy.envelope.subtitle: Open it when you have a minute.
copy.welcome.subtitle: I've been saving these up.
copy.openWhen.title: For the days in between
copy.openWhen.subtitle: Open one when the label fits.
copy.closing.title: Not long now.

content.text: Write about where you are right now — the actual room, the weather, what the day sounded like. Distance shrinks when the detail is real.
These are sealed. Open one when the label fits — not before, or they stop working.

memories.title: The last time we were in the same room
memories.description: What you did, and the bit you keep thinking about.

memories.title: The call that helped
memories.description: The one that went on far too long and was worth every minute.

memories.title: Last week
memories.description: Something small and recent, so it doesn't all feel like history.

openWhen.label: the distance feels like too much
openWhen.content: Don't try to fix it. Just say you know, and that it's temporary.

openWhen.label: you've had a bad day
openWhen.content: Short and warm. Nothing that needs a reply.

openWhen.label: something good happened
openWhen.content: Tell them you'd have been the first one cheering.

openWhen.label: you can't sleep
openWhen.content: A quiet one. Read it in bed with the light off.

openWhen.label: it's nearly time
openWhen.content: The one for the week before you see each other.

openWhen.label: you land
openWhen.content: Write this for the exact moment they get off the plane, wherever it's landing.

openWhen.label: you finally book the ticket
openWhen.content: Save this to open yourself, the day the flight is actually booked.

openWhen.label: it's been three months apart
openWhen.content: Write what you'd want them to know exactly a quarter of the way through.

openWhen.label: you're doubting this is worth it
openWhen.content: The honest one. Write it for the night they actually wonder if this makes sense.

futureLetter.title: Read this when we're in the same place
futureLetter.content: Write to the version of you both who made it through this stretch. They'll want to hear it.
